description: A burgundy red knee-length tunic with long sleeves, gold patterned borders along the front, cuffs, neck and hem, and a cream shirt visible at the collar and wrists. A dark brown shoulder mantle is fastened by a round metal brooch and edged with red-and-gold trim. A dark leather-looking belt with a gold-colored rectangular buckle and round decorative studs wraps the waist, with a hanging strap end and small ornate terminal. Brown trousers and tall soft brown boots appear below the tunic. Exact textile fibres and leather composition are uncertain.
